name: Marius Corvane
title: Legate
role: The Hegemony's envoy to the fleet
note: A smooth Hegemony diplomat at Haven Station, always carrying a generous offer and a long contract.
appearance: Handsome, well fed and beautifully tailored, which is its own kind of insult to anyone from the fleet.
personality: Charming, reasonable and tireless. He has never once lost his temper in public.
voice: Warm and conversational, as though you're already friends. Everything is an "opportunity", and every threat is "an unfortunate possibility".
goals: Bring the fleet under Hegemony protection without firing a shot, and be rewarded for it.
secrets: He's terrified of the Regent. He has seen what happens to the unmarked ships, and he would trade almost anything for a way out.
